knowledge:
- key_parameters: objectCond1=A list of MSnSet objects containing the replicates for the first condition (e.g., control) ;; objectCond2=A list of MSnSet objects containing the replicates for the second condition (e.g., treatment) ;; fcol=The feature column in the MSnSets indicating the markers, with non-markers labeled "unknown" (default is "markers") ;; numIter=The number of MCMC iterations; 10,000+ is recommended for convergence, with 1,000 as a bare minimum ;; burnin=The number of initial MCMC samples to discard; typically 10% to 50% of the total iterations ;; thin=Thinning frequency to reduce autocorrelation; default is 5, but can be increased up to 20 if memory is constrained ;; gpParams=Parameters from fitting Gaussian processes to marker profiles; recommended to fit outside the bandle function using fitGPmaternPC for stability ;; pcPrior=Numeric vector of length 3 (length-scale, amplitude, variance) for the penalised complexity prior; default is c(0.5, 3, 100) ;; dirPrior=Dirichlet matrix prior on mixing weights (K x K matrix); off-diagonal terms (representing translocation probability) should be at least two orders of magnitude smaller than diagonal terms ;; numChains=Number of parallel MCMC chains; minimum of 4 is recommended
- alternatives: TAGM (T-augmented Gaussian mixture model) is mentioned as the inspiration for single-condition spatial proteomics, but bandle should be preferred when comparing two distinct experimental conditions to identify translocating proteins.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have quantitative spatial proteomics data (e.g., LOPIT, LOPIT-DC, hyperLOPIT) with replicate experiments across two different conditions (e.g., unstimulated vs. stimulated) and want to identify proteins that change their subcellular localisation.
- pitfalls: Failing to check MCMC convergence (Gelman diagnostics should be < 1.2, and trace plots should look like "hairy caterpillars") ;; Not discarding unconverged chains (if a chain is bad in one condition, it must be discarded from both conditions) ;; Using too few MCMC iterations (e.g., 100 iterations is only for quick testing; real analyses require 10,000+) ;; Not matching features/channels across conditions (the datasets must have the same number of channels and the same proteins).

workflows.name: differential_localisation_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential subcellular localisation analysis on mass-spectrometry-based spatial proteomics data across two conditions.
input: control_replicates.RData (list of MSnSet objects for condition 1)
treatment_replicates.RData (list of MSnSet objects for condition 2)
workflows.stages:
1. Extract common features across replicates using commonFeatureNames.
2. Fit Gaussian processes to marker profiles using fitGPmaternPC.
3. Set up and check the Dirichlet prior on mixing weights using prior_pred_dir.
4. Run the main MCMC model using bandle.
5. Assess MCMC convergence using calculateGelman and plotOutliers.
6. Subset/remove unconverged chains if necessary.
7. Process the MCMC results using bandleProcess.
8. Predict subcellular localisation and append results using bandlePredict.
9. Apply probability and outlier thresholds using getPredictions.
10. Extract differential localisation probabilities using diffLocalisationProb.
11. Visualize translocations using plotTranslocations and plotTable.
12. Estimate uncertainty using bootstrapdiffLocprob or binomialDiffLocProb.
workflows.code:
thplopit <- commonFeatureNames(c(thpLOPIT_unstimulated_rep1_mulvey2021, thpLOPIT_unstimulated_rep3_mulvey2021, thpLOPIT_lps_rep1_mulvey2021, thpLOPIT_lps_rep3_mulvey2021))
K <- length(getMarkerClasses(thplopit[[1]], fcol = "markers"))
pc_prior <- matrix(NA, ncol = 3, K)
pc_prior[seq.int(1:K), ] <- matrix(rep(c(1, 60, 100), each = K), ncol = 3)
gpParams <- lapply(thplopit, function(x) fitGPmaternPC(x, hyppar = pc_prior))
plotGPmatern(thplopit[[1]], gpParams[[1]])
set.seed(1)
dirPrior = diag(rep(1, K)) + matrix(0.0005, nrow = K, ncol = K)
predDirPrior <- prior_pred_dir(object = thplopit[[1]], dirPrior = dirPrior, q = 15)
control <- list(thplopit[[1]], thplopit[[2]])
treatment <- list(thplopit[[3]], thplopit[[4]])
params <- bandle(objectCond1 = control, objectCond2 = treatment, numIter = 10, burnin = 5L, thin = 1L, gpParams = gpParams, pcPrior = pc_prior, numChains = 4, dirPrior = dirPrior, seed = 1)
calculateGelman(params)
plotOutliers(params)
params_converged <- params[-c(1, 4)]
params_converged <- bandleProcess(params_converged)
bandle_out <- summaries(params_converged)
xx <- bandlePredict(control, treatment, params = params_converged, fcol = "markers")
res_0h <- xx[[1]]
res_12h <- xx[[2]]
res_0h[[1]] <- getPredictions(res_0h[[1]], fcol = "bandle.allocation", scol = "bandle.probability", mcol = "markers", t = .99)
res_12h[[1]] <- getPredictions(res_12h[[1]], fcol = "bandle.allocation", scol = "bandle.probability", mcol = "markers", t = .99)
fData(res_0h[[1]])$bandle.outlier.t <- 1 - fData(res_0h[[1]])$bandle.outlier
fData(res_12h[[1]])$bandle.outlier.t <- 1 - fData(res_12h[[1]])$bandle.outlier
res_0h[[1]] <- getPredictions(res_0h[[1]], fcol = "bandle.allocation.pred", scol = "bandle.outlier.t", mcol = "markers", t = .99)
res_12h[[1]] <- getPredictions(res_12h[[1]], fcol = "bandle.allocation.pred", scol = "bandle.outlier.t", mcol = "markers", t = .99)
dl <- diffLocalisationProb(params_converged)
plotTranslocations(dl_msnsets, fcol = "bandle.allocation.pred", col = dl_cols)
plotTranslocations(dl_msnsets, fcol = "bandle.allocation.pred", col = dl_cols, type = "chord")
plotTable(dl_msnsets, fcol = "bandle.allocation.pred")
boot_t <- bootstrapdiffLocprob(params = bandleres, top = 100, Bootsample = 5000, decreasing = TRUE)
bin_t <- binomialDiffLocProb(params = bandleres, top = 100, nsample = 5000, decreasing = TRUE)
EFDR(dl, threshold = 0.95)
